title: French dairy giant Lactalis recalls baby formula in 18 countries due to toxin
summary: French dairy maker Lactalis has recalled baby formula in 18 countries after it was discovered that some batches may contain a dangerous toxin. Since the start of this year, three of the world’s biggest dairy companies, including also Nestlé and Danone, have issued recalls on baby milk due to contamination scares. August Hakansson tells us more.
